equation_summary: M2RNN keeps a MATRIX memory state h in [B,N,K,V]. Per step s with input outer product x_s = k_s ⊗ v_s: candidate = tanh( h_{s-1} @ W + x_s ); h_s = f_s * h_{s-1} + (1 - f_s) * candidate, where f_s is a per-token scalar gate (from xf). The read y_s = q_s @ h_s (project the matrix state by query). Weights W shared across steps. This is a closed NONLINEAR (tanh) matrix-memory gated transition, not an affine scan; the state is a matrix and the update passes through tanh and a data-dependent gate.
state_shape: matrix memory h [B,N,K,V] (per-head K x V)
gate_scope: data-dependent scalar gate f_s plus tanh nonlinearity; fixed shared W

direction_justification: M2RNN is a closed nonlinear (tanh) matrix-memory gated recurrence with a data-dependent scalar gate; it does not map to the affine linear K2 law and provides no reusable descriptor for other families, so it stays an external comparator.
